## Step 4: Solve for (x - 1)(y - 8)
Solving for $(x - 1)(y - 8)$ gives us $(x - 1)(y - 8) = -3$.

We know that neither $x - 1$ nor $y - 8$ can be $0$ as their sum would be greater than $11$. Also, we can cancel out the negative sign, obtaining $(x - 1)(y - 8) = 3$.
